<script setup lang="ts">
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const props = defineProps<{
  title?: string
  description?: string
  customClass?: string
}>()

const computedClass = computed(() => {
  return cn(
    `
      min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col gap-4 bg-slate-50 p-4  transition-colors
      duration-300
      sm:p-6
      dark:bg-slate-950
    `,
    props.customClass,
  )
})
</script>

<template>
  <view :class="computedClass">
    <view v-if="title || description || $slots.header" class="space-y-2">
      <slot name="header">
        <view v-if="title" class="
            text-xl font-bold text-slate-900
            dark:text-white
          ">
          {{ title }}
        </view>
        <view v-if="description" class="
            text-slate-500
            dark:text-slate-400
          ">
          {{ description }}
        </view>
      </slot>
    </view>

    <slot />
  </view>
</template>
